$comment: Extensions served from the editor's own origin as a static GitHub-proxy snapshot (/api/gh/...).
forward/build/gh-snapshot.js fetches each root at its pinned tag, follows every github: dependency, and writes what the editor would otherwise ask makecode.com for.
Pin tags, never branches. 'unpinned' gives the tag to use when a dependency names a repo without one (pxt-jacdac's service packages do this).

tutorialDependencies: extension versions the home-gallery tutorials and converted projects pin (forward/content/learn). Served like roots but left out of extension search. learn-gallery.js --check fails if one is missing.
